hero.title: Faster claims, smarter decisions, lower costs
hero.summary: True Aim checks every claim against the policy wording, benchmarks every invoice and prepares every damage report, with the calculations shown. Your team receives finished work and keeps the final say: the AI reads and calculates, your adjusters decide. Every step is recorded, so each decision can be explained to a customer, an auditor or a regulator.

compliance.heading: Compliant by design
paragraphs: Every decision maps to the clause it rests on, the evidence it used and the person who made it. Your auditors, your regulator and your customers can request the full audit trail at the click of a button.
True Aim sits alongside the systems you already run. Your data stays yours, and so do your rules, limits and thresholds.
compliance.imageAlt: A metal lock carrying the True Aim symbol

items.question: Who makes the final decision on a claim?
items.answer: Your team. True Aim prepares the recommendation, the calculations and the reasoning for an adjuster to confirm. Full automation runs only where you and your regulator allow it.

items.question: Does True Aim replace the systems we already run?
items.answer: No. True Aim works above your claims and finance systems, reads from them and writes the results back into them.

items.question: What does True Aim need from us to start?
items.answer: Your policy wording or rules and a sample of past claims. True Aim's team configures the decision logic with yours before anything runs on live claims.

items.question: How is True Aim priced?
items.answer: Per outcome, not per seat. You pay for each settled claim, benchmarked invoice or completed damage report, so costs scale with the value you receive.

items.question: Which claims can True Aim handle?
items.answer: Motor, property, warranty and liability claims use the same building blocks. A claim can start from the customer's own photographs or from an assessor's report, an estimate or an invoice.
